publish_invariants: No legal document is public unless status=published and owner_approved=true.
Published documents require non-empty owner/counsel supplied content and effective/published timestamps.
Public launch is blocked until all required documents are active and Business Identity is published.
Legal text is never auto-generated into production without explicit review and Owner approval.
Legal delivery surfaces render database text as plain text and do not execute embedded markup.
launch_invariant: Global legal pages are necessary but not sufficient; each target market must also pass its own market-specific review.
